audit.evidence: Real Vtiger CRM 6.3.0/6.4.0 booted from Docker Hub javanile/vtiger images (SourceForge releases + install dump) with mariadb sidecar; driven as admin through the real Settings>CompanyDetails logo-upload form (real __vtrftk token). Live gate: plaintext PHP logo executes flag@v0, blocked (mime sniff) @v1, GIF89a+PHP polyglot .php executes flag@v1. passed=true (Variant A same-sink, no v2).

v0_vulnerable.ref: javanile/vtiger:6.3.0 (Docker Hub; bakes the SourceForge vtigercrm 6.3.0 release + fresh install dump on php:5.6.40-apache)

v1_incomplete.ref: javanile/vtiger:6.4.0 (Docker Hub; SourceForge vtigercrm 6.4.0 release; CompanyDetailsSave adds mime_content_type() sniff = the CVE-2015-6000 fix)

v2_fixed.version: n/a (Variant A: same-sink content bypass, no V2 required for the gate)

flag.resource: a per-run secret readable only by executing an uploaded PHP file (the RCE the company-logo upload guard defends against)
flag.placement: /flag/pcb_flag.txt inside each vtiger container, OUTSIDE the docroot (/var/www/html); planted from $PCB_FLAG by the compose command (environment, not app code) before the image's own boot; a normal GET can never read it, only a written+executed PHP web shell at test/logo/<name>.php can echo it
flag.detect: flag token substring in the GET response body of the uploaded PHP file

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the Settings_Vtiger_CompanyDetailsSave_Action class in modules/Settings/Vtiger/actions/CompanyDetailsSave.php in Vtiger CRM 6.4.0 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary code by uploading a crafted image file with an executable extension, and then accessing it via a direct request to the file in test/logo/, ... because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2015-6000.

status.frozen_2026-08-02: UPGRADED from gate_passed by real gate run (2026-08-02): v0/v1/v2 up on real javanile/vtiger images; gate passed=True; bypass@V2 6.5.0 -> LBL_INVALID_IMAGE guard + 404 (GIF89a+<?= polyglot blocked). Added v2 service to compose (db-v2 + v2:6.5.0, port 39462) + BASE v2 in oracle.

provenance.notes: Real Docker gate run 2026-07-11 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate` (profiles v0+v1, fresh containers, random flag PCBFLAG_9e6692b834f82244211665a29c90cfc8); passed=true, _env_ready={v0:true,v1:true}. Source-verified by extracting modules/Settings/Vtiger/actions/CompanyDetailsSave.php and modules/Settings/Vtiger/models/CompanyDetails.php from BOTH javanile/vtiger:6.3.0 and :6.4.0 images (no offensive PoC repo used). DEFENSE under test = the company-logo upload validation in Settings_Vtiger_CompanyDetailsSave_Action::process(). Both 6.3.0 and 6.4.0 share (a) a client-MIME check on $_FILES['logo']['type'] (attacker-controlled multipart Content-Type -> we send image/gif) and (b) a content regex preg_match('/(<\?php?(.*?))/i') that only matches the literal '<?ph'/'<?php' (sidestepped in BOTH versions with the '<?=' short-echo tag). The CVE-2015-6000 fix shipped in 6.4.0 ADDS a server-side mime_content_type() sniff (must be image/*). saveLogo() still writes the upload verbatim to the web-reachable test/logo/<original-name> keeping the attacker .php extension (name/extension never validated). Seed (CVE-2015-6000) = plain-text PHP body uploaded as logo pcb_seed.php: EXECUTES on V0 (no sniff), on V1 the sniff sees text/plain -> redirect &error=LBL_INVALID_IMAGE, file never written -> GET 404 (BLOCKED). Residual (CVE-2016-1713) = the identical flow but the body is a real GIF89a magic + PHP polyglot uploaded as pcb_bypass.php ('crafted image file with an executable extension'): mime_content_type -> image/gif passes the added check, file lands as test/logo/pcb_bypass.php and EXECUTES on V1 (flag exfiltrated via RCE). Variant A (same sink, same flag channel: an executed uploaded .php echoing the environment-planted canary at /flag/pcb_flag.txt, outside docroot). Driven as the install-seeded admin (admin/admin) through vtiger's real Settings>CompanyDetails form (__vtrftk token scraped per request); no app business code is modified. Recipe images from Docker Hub (javanile/vtiger) bake the SourceForge releases + a fresh install DB dump; a mariadb:10.5 sidecar per version imports the dump at boot (MYSQL_TYPE=mysqli since the image lacks the legacy mysql ext). No images/source committed to the case dir.
